questions.question: It was not until I had finished my degree that I realized the importance of developing a personal brand.
options: I didn't realize the importance of developing a personal brand until after I finished my degree.
It wasn't until I'd finished my degree that I realized the importance of developing a personal brand.
The importance of developing a personal brand was not something I realized until after finishing my degree.
I didn't finish my degree until after realizing the importance of developing a personal brand.
questions.answer: It wasn't until I'd finished my degree that I realized the importance of developing a personal brand.

questions.question: Unless you had studied hard, you wouldn't have passed the exam.
options: You would pass the exam unless you hadn't studied hard.
If you hadn't studied hard, then you wouldn't have passed the exam.
Had you not studied hard, you wouldn't have passed the exam.
You wouldn't have passed the exam if you had studied hard.
questions.answer: Unless you had studied hard, you wouldn't have passed the exam.

questions.question: The new policy would be implemented only if the board of directors agreed to it.
options: Only if the board of directors agreed to it would the new policy be implemented.
The new policy would not be implemented unless the board of directors agreed to it.
It was only when the board of directors agreed to it that the new policy would be implemented.
Unless the board of directors agreed to it, the new policy wouldn't be implemented.
questions.answer: Only if the board of directors agreed to it would the new policy be implemented.

questions.question: It is essential that the manager be informed immediately.
options: The manager must be informed immediately.
That the manager should be informed immediately is essential.
For the manager to be informed immediately is crucial.
Being informed immediately by the manager is not necessary.
questions.answer: It is essential that the manager be informed immediately.

questions.question: I was surprised when she said that she had never been to Paris, even though she claimed to have traveled extensively.
options: She claimed to have traveled extensively, yet she had never been to Paris.
Even though she claimed to have traveled extensively, it turned out that she had never been to Paris.
It was surprising that she said she'd never been to Paris, given her extensive travel history.
Although she claimed to have traveled extensively, she actually hadn't been to Paris.
questions.answer: Even though she claimed to have traveled extensively, it turned out that she had never been to Paris.
